<!-- Shared prompt source: https://github.com/bardphysicslab/engineering-standards/blob/main/.github/pull_request_template.md . Keep small fixes brief; no extra ceremony or tests by default. -->

## Result and issue
<!-- Concrete behavior and owning issue. -->

## Architecture and decisions
<!-- Affected contracts/state owners/invariants and why the change respects them; material departures link an accepted decision. “Checked” alone is insufficient. Use N/A with a short reason when appropriate. -->

## Acceptance evidence
<!-- Map each criterion to the relevant change and evidence, including revision, level and limits. Focused tests, inspection, browser/simulation or hardware evidence as appropriate. Reuse unchanged evidence. -->

| Criterion | Satisfying change | Evidence and limits |
| --- | --- | --- |
| | | |

## Documentation and delivery
<!-- Relevant architecture, Mermaid, contract, decision index, data tables and usage/runbook changes, or why none are needed. Distinguish design accepted/code tested/merged/deployed/physical evidence. -->

## Review, authorization and handoff
<!-- Exact-head review/authorized exception; authorization scope; next owner/action; release/recovery and consumer adoption only when applicable. No secrets. -->
